ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  The promoter and promoter group of AAREY DRUGS & PHARMACEUTICALS LTD have substantially increased their direct ownership by converting 2,370,000 warrants into equity shares, boosting their collective stake by 7.71% to approximately 45.42% of the total share capital. This conversion materially consolidates control within the promoter group, but a notable inconsistency exists in the reported number of converted shares across different sections of the document, indicating a potential data reconciliation issue.
